name: queue
title: Queues
description: Cloudflare Queues for Lunora — declare push or pull consumers with `defineQueue`, and codegen wires typed `ctx.queues.<name>.send(...)` on mutation/action context plus the `queue()` Worker export. Scaffolds a sample email queue with a push consumer.
docs: After installing, run `lunora codegen` — codegen discovers `defineQueue()` calls in lunora/queues.ts and generates typed `ctx.queues` producers on Mutation/ActionCtx, a `queue()` export in the Worker entry, and the matching `queues.producers[]` / `queues.consumers[]` entries in wrangler.jsonc. Add more queues by declaring additional `defineQueue()` exports. For pull consumers (HTTP), set `mode: "pull"` in the config and expose your own endpoint.
